source_document_header: 2026-27 NBA REGULAR SEASON SCHEDULE AS OF AUGUST 13, 2026 | SUBJECT TO CHANGE
extraction_tool: fetch_page (PDF text extraction), chunks 1 and 2 of 13
purpose: The look-back window (11/10-11/13) and the look-forward window (11/14-11/18) that are needed to compute rest days, back-to-back flags and 3-in-4 flags for the games inside the three-day window. Rows 231-252 are the same 22 games already published on the slate page.
extraction_notes: Rows 211-214 print an 'at' token between the two teams; the away team is TEAM 1 and the home team is TEAM 2.

Rows 215-259 print no 'at' token. Where the official 11/14 05:00 PM injury report prints an AWAY@HOME matchup code for the same game, that code is used for the away/home basis and the row records it. In all 14 corroborated rows the schedule's printed order is AWAY then HOME.
Rest days, back-to-back flags and 3-in-4 flags depend only on dates, so they are computed for every row regardless of the away/home basis.
Travel distance additionally needs the home venue of the previous game; it is left blank where the away/home basis or the arena coordinate is not confirmed by an official source.
Row 259 prints LOCAL 7:00 PM and ET 8:00 PM, which is inconsistent with the printed order read as AWAY then HOME; the row is flagged.

games.internal_inconsistency: This row prints LOCAL 7:00 PM and ET 8:00 PM. With the printed order read as AWAY then HOME the home venue (Indiana, Eastern) would print ET equal to LOCAL, which this row does not. The row is kept for rest/B2B/3-in-4 arithmetic, which does not depend on the away/home basis, and is flagged for review.
